source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of epistasis, block for block (PDF 98-100).

blocks.text: Zyada tar khasiyatein mukhtalif genes ke aapas ke amal (interaction) se banti hain. Yeh interactions do bari qismon ke hain:

items: Allelic interactions: aik hi gene ke alleles aapas mein amal karte hain. Misalein: incomplete dominance, codominance aur multiple alleles.
Non-allelic interactions: mukhtalif genes (mukhtalif loci par) ke alleles aapas mein amal karte hain. Is ki aam misaal epistasis hai.

blocks.text: Epistasis genes ka aisa amal hai jis mein aik allele doosre genes (doosre loci par) ke alleles ka asar chhupa (mask) deta ya badal deta hai. Jo allele asar chhupata ya badalta hai use epistatic kehte hain, aur jis allele ka asar chhup jata ya badal jata hai use hypostatic. Kitab ki misaal: insanon mein ganj-pan (baldness) ka allele kaale aur sunehre (blonde) baalon ke alleles par epistatic hai, kyunke ganje sar par baalon ka rang nazar hi nahi aata.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text:
Polygenic inheritance aur epistasis dono mein aik se zyada genes hote hain, lekin dono alag tareeqe se kaam karte hain.
Polygenic inheritance mein bohat se genes mil kar, har aik thora sa asar dal kar, khasiyat banate hain; is se continuous variation (musalsal farq) aata hai.
Epistasis mein aik allele doosre gene ka asar chhupata ya badalta hai; is se aam taur par discontinuous variation aata hai, yaani khasiyat ki saaf alag alag qismein.
Labrador kutton ke baalon (coat) ka rang

Bohat se janwaron mein baalon ka rang epistasis se control hota hai, jis mein aik gene doosre par asar dalta hai. Misaal: Labrador kutton mein baalon ka rang (kaala, bhoora, peela) do genes par munhasir hai:

items: B gene pigment ka rang tay karta hai. Dominant allele B kaala rang aur recessive b bhoora rang deta hai. Is liye BB ya Bb kaala aur bb bhoora hota hai.

E gene baalon mein pigment jama hone (deposition) ko control karta hai. Dominant E pigment jama hone deta hai, lekin recessive e (ee ki soorat mein) B ya b par epistatic hai aur baalon mein pigment jama nahi hone deta. Is liye EE ya Ee wale kutton ke baalon mein rang hota hai, lekin ee wale kutte peele hote hain, chahe B ho ya b.

blocks.text: Jab do heterozygous kaale kutton (BbEe × BbEe) ka cross kiya jaye to bachche kaale, bhoore aur peele 9:3:4 ratio mein hote hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: kaala, bhoora aur peela Labrador aur un ke genotypes: kaala BBEE, BBEe, BbEE ya BbEe; bhoora bbEE ya bbEe; peela BBee, Bbee ya bbee. Neeche: do kaale BbEe kutton ka cross; 4 x 4 grid (oopar sperm BE, Be, bE, be, baen eggs) har bachche ka genotype aur rang deta hai: 9 kaale, 3 bhoore, 4 peele.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.8: Labrador ke baalon ke rang ke genotypes aur phenotypes (kitab ki Figure 18.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Grid ki qataarein (eggs) BE, Be, bE, be; har khane mein genotype aur Black, Brown ya Yellow likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Grid mein har woh khana jis mein ee hai peela hai (4 khane), chahe B ho ya b. Baqi mein B_ wale kaale (9) aur bb wale bhoore (3). Is tarah 9:3:3:1 ke aakhri do hisse (3 + 1) mil kar 4 peele ban jate hain: 9 : 3 : 4.

blocks.title: Bombay phenotype
blocks.text: ABO genotypes ka zahir hona aik aur gene H par bhi munhasir hai. Yeh gene aik khaas H substance banata hai, jo A ya B antigens ka pehla maadda (precursor) hai. Alleles Iᴬ aur Iᴮ aise enzymes banate hain jo H substance ko antigen-A aur antigen-B mein badalte hain. Agar kisi ke paas Iᴬ aur Iᴮ alleles hon lekin us ka genotype hh ho to woh H substance nahi banata. Is liye us ke Iᴬ aur Iᴮ alleles A aur B antigens nahi bana pate, aur A aur B antigens na hone ki wajah se us ka phenotype O hota hai. Ise Bombay phenotype kehte hain kyunke yeh 1952 mein Bombay mein daryaft hua. Yeh zyada tar India, Bangladesh, Pakistan aur Iran mein milta hai.
Foxglove paudon mein phool ka rang (gehra surkh, halka surkh aur safaid) do genes (gene D aur gene W) ke aapas ke amal se control hota hai:

items: Gene D: dominant allele D gehri surkh pattiyan (petals) banata hai aur recessive d halki surkh. Is liye DD ya Dd gehra surkh aur dd halka surkh hota hai.

Gene W (doosre locus par): dominant allele W pigment (jo D ya d banate hain) ko chhote chhote dhabbon tak mehdood kar deta hai, is liye pattiyan bahar se safaid nazar aati hain. Recessive w pigment ko poori patti par yaksan phailne deta hai.

blocks.text: Heterozygous DdWw paude ke phool safaid hote hain, kyunke W allele pigment ko andar ki taraf chhote dhabbon tak mehdood rakhta hai. Agar aise paude ko self-fertilize kiya jaye to safaid, gehre surkh aur halke surkh phool 12:3:1 ratio mein aate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: gehre surkh, halke surkh aur safaid foxglove ke phool aur un ke genotypes: gehra surkh DDww ya Ddww; halka surkh ddww; safaid DDWW, DDWw, DdWW, DdWw, ddWW ya ddWw. Neeche: do safaid DdWw paudon ka cross; 4 x 4 grid (oopar nar gametes DW, Dw, dW, dw, baen maada gametes) har bachche ka genotype aur rang deta hai: 12 safaid, 3 gehre surkh, 1 halka surkh.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.9: Foxglove ke phool ke rang ke genotypes aur phenotypes (kitab ki Figure 18.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Grid ki qataarein (female gametes) DW, Dw, dW, dw; har khane mein genotype aur White, Dark red ya Light red likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Asal qaida: jis paude mein kam az kam aik W ho woh safaid hai, chahe D ho ya d (12 khane). Sirf ww mein rang nazar aata hai: D ke saath gehra surkh (3 khane), dd ke saath halka surkh (1 khana). Is tarah 12 : 3 : 1.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.9 ki legend mein safaid phool ke genotypes sirf DDWW, DdWW aur DdWw likhe hain. Lekin har woh paudha jis mein kam az kam aik W ho safaid hai, is liye safaid ke chhe genotypes hain: DDWW, DDWw, DdWW, DdWw, ddWW aur ddWw, jaisa hamare khaake mein hai.

blocks.prompt: BbEe × BbEe Labradors mein peele kutte 16 mein se 4 kyun hain, 3 kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Har ee kutta peela hai: 3 B_ee aur 1 bbee = 4. 9:3:3:1 ki do qismein (B_ee aur bbee) mil jati hain kyunke ee, B aur b dono ko chhupa deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Bombay phenotype wala shakhs test mein group O aata hai lekin us ke genes IᴬIᴮ hain. H gene par us ka genotype kya hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: hh. Woh H substance nahi banata, is liye Iᴬ aur Iᴮ ke enzymes ke paas A ya B antigens banane ke liye maadda hi nahi hota.

items: Allelic interactions: aik gene ke alleles (incomplete dominance, codominance, multiple alleles); non-allelic: mukhtalif genes (epistasis).
Epistasis: aik locus ka allele doosre locus ke alleles ka asar chhupata ya badalta hai (epistatic aur hypostatic).
Labrador BbEe × BbEe: 9 kaale : 3 bhoore : 4 peele.
Bombay phenotype: hh se group O, ABO alleles kuch bhi hon.
Foxglove DdWw self-fertilization: 12 safaid : 3 gehre surkh : 1 halka surkh.
